From. Report on the Secretary of the Navy, with an appendix, containing reports from officers. December, 1864). opp. p. 630. Map shows the "Position of the Kearsarge when she received the first broadside of the enemy," the general direction of the ships during the battle, and the position of the Alabama, when it sank in 45 fathoms of water. Map accompanies "Captain [John A.] Winslow's detailed report of the action" dated July 30, 1864. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:41,000. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 703 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
